patch_description: Combines the best elements of both parents: (1) the antipodal-symmetric parametrization (7 generators -> 14 points) with soft-min (log-sum-exp) SLSQP from the current program, which halves the search dimension and enforces the structure of the known optimum; (2) the repulsion pre-optimizer, diverse seed set (icosahedron+perturbed poles, Fibonacci, random ball/sphere), bottleneck kick-polish and lazy seed generation with early exit from the inspiration program. Pipeline per seed: repulsion (optional, cheap) -> symmetrize to generators -> softmin SLSQP (two betas) -> exact-min SLSQP polish -> bottleneck micro-polish. Early exit once ratio ~0.4895 is reached, plus a time budget guard. This should match the reference score of 1.00 while keeping runtime moderate.
